basics.name: David (Jiachen) Weng
basics.label: Bilingual Customer Service & Community Engagement Professional
basics.summary: Friendly and welcoming customer service professional with 2+ years of front-line experience serving a diverse community of 1,500+ residents at UBC. Bilingual (English & Mandarin) with strong written and verbal communication, proven ability to plan, organize, and follow through on duties. Passionate about public libraries as welcoming spaces for learning, joy, and community, and committed to Vancouver Public Library's inclusive service values.

work.name: UBC Student Housing and Hospitality Services
work.summary: Front-line customer service and community programming for a residence community of 1,500+ students.
highlights: Front-line point of contact for 1,500+ residents, responding daily to inquiries with prompt, courteous service
Staffed rotating duty and on-call shifts (weekdays, evenings, weekends), de-escalating concerns and enforcing campus safety policies
Designed and delivered 12+ community programs per year (25-60+ attendees each), fostering inclusion across culturally diverse communities
Produced monthly newsletters and maintained accurate, confidential duty and incident records in line with university policy
